artifacts.summary: Re-verifies seed figures (suite count drifted 149->195; 17-gate @extensions set and gate8 cost confirmed), rules out the gate cache as a touched-path source, and recommends a backward-compatible opt-in touched-paths input to gate8_run plus a forced-dirty cache-write guard, scoped entirely inside the task's own file_scope, with call-site wiring left as a coordinated follow-on with sibling task 585.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 584 to create an implementation plan from this research.

memory_candidates.content: gate-cache-lib.sh's persisted cache entry (gate_cache_entry_write/read) stores only ONE opaque composite hash per gate -- never per-file hashes. It cannot supply a touched-path diff; the gate cache answers 'did the corpus change' but never 'which files changed'. The only existing touched-path source in this codebase is the orchestrator's invocation_modified_files/cycle_modified_files, built from each agent's own self-reported .return-meta.json modified_files and accumulated in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh -- not derivable from the gate cache itself.

verify-deploy.sh's generic --skip-unchanged cache-write block (~line 2251) writes a cache entry for any gate that ran clean this invocation, keyed by the gate's DECLARED corpus (e.g. the whole @extensions tree for gate 8), with no awareness of whether that gate's own internal invocation was narrowed to a subset. Any future narrowing of a gate's internal suite/check selection (gate 8 or otherwise) must force that gate onto GATE_DIRTY_LIST whenever narrowing was used, regardless of pass/fail outcome -- otherwise a narrowed-but-clean pass silently certifies the full corpus as green under --skip-unchanged, and a later unrelated run with an unchanged corpus skips the gate entirely.

Of verify-deploy.sh's three call sites to Gate 8, only orchestrate-batch-gate.sh's Move 4 (full depth, no --skip-slow) actually runs the full shell-test battery at cost; orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's pre/post findings snapshots pass --skip-slow, which makes gate8_run() return before run-all.sh is ever invoked -- those calls get zero benefit from any Gate 8 narrowing and are not a useful target. Mechanism A's --only-gate 8 scoped-tier option is also currently NOT suite-level narrow (gate8_run runs the full battery regardless of which gates were selected via --only-gate).
